title: Myro Weekly
description: Free weekly hiring intelligence. Real skill demand data from thousands of live job postings.

items.title: Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai Hire for the Same Jobs. At Bengaluru, the Odds Change for the Same Job.
items.summary: Engineering is 42-44% of postings in Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad and Chennai. The four cities are one market by composition. Bengaluru holds 47.8% of the country's engineering openings. Same job, seven times the shots — and a free skill-gap analysis to see which is blocking you.

items.title: Only 8% of India's open jobs will hire a fresher
items.summary: Only 7.9% of India's open roles will take a fresher, and technology is the worst at 1.7%. Here is where the fresher jobs actually sit, plus a free skill check.

items.title: Two Industries Are Quietly Hiring 5× Harder Than Tech. Neither Is the One You're Watching.
items.summary: Everyone watches tech hiring. The jobs are somewhere else. In the second week of July 2026, consulting and BFSI carried 62% of all active postings — more than five times technology. And the AI roles you imagine sit at product companies are actually concentrated inside the consulting giants.

items.title: Bengaluru Builds, Mumbai Banks, Hyderabad Ships. Your City Is Quietly Picking Your Skills.
items.summary: Same country, four different job markets. In the second week of July 2026, Bengaluru's postings ask for AI and platform engineering, Mumbai's for banking and regulation, Hyderabad's for delivery and QA, and Delhi's for AI consulting. Where you live is quietly choosing your skills — and AI is the one that travels everywhere.

items.title: Agentic AI Hit 843 Job Posts in the Second Week of July 2026. We Checked What's Real.
items.summary: In the second week of July 2026, 843 India postings named 'Agentic AI' as a required skill — up from a handful in spring. But 499 came from a single company. Before you panic that you're behind, sit down. We looked properly. The real number is 344, spread across 73 employers and 8 industries.

items.title: From DevOps to Loop Engineering: A Four-Skill Jump
items.summary: DevOps and SRE appear in 375 India postings; loop engineering in zero. The gap is four skills, not a career change. A free ladder from SRE to AI-agent reliability.

items.title: Loop Engineering: The Skill With Zero Job Titles in 2026
items.summary: Zero postings say 'loop engineering.' But 213 say 'Generative AI Agents' and 30 say 'AI Agent Monitoring.' The job is hiring — free 90-day plan to do it before the title catches up.

items.title: India's Hiring Supermajority Isn't Tech in 2026
items.summary: In 38,138 active India roles, BFSI and consulting hold 18,698 — nearly 3× pure tech. A free June 2026 breakdown, and the one employer that tops them all.

items.title: One in Four India Roles Is in Bengaluru 2026
items.summary: Bengaluru holds 8,991 of 34,959 India roles in our June 2026 data — one in four. See the top employers and a free skill-gap analysis.

items.title: Banks Out-Hire Big Tech in India 2026
items.summary: In 35,000 India roles, BFSI posted 8,182 — more than double the technology sector. A free June 2026 hiring breakdown with the top banks.

items.title: Siemens Hiring India 2026: 1,461 Roles
items.summary: A June 2026 snapshot of 1,461 active Siemens India roles — more than Wipro or Accenture in our dataset. Free skill-gap analysis inside.

items.title: NCR Job Search 2026: The 20-company Watchlist
items.summary: The free NCR job-search watchlist expands from 13 loaded companies to 20 targets across consulting, fintech, data and product.

items.title: Consulting and Data Roles Lead the NCR Fit Map
items.summary: The free NCR fit map ranked 75 job leads. Strategy & Consulting and Data & Analytics take 58 of them.

items.title: NCR Job Hunt 2026: 245 Roles Across 13 Companies
items.summary: A private target-company search became a free NCR hiring map: 245 roles, 124 strong-fit leads, and 13 companies to work first.

items.title: Semiconductor Hiring India 2026: 1,016 Roles
items.summary: A May 2026 snapshot of 1,016 semiconductor jobs across AMD, Qualcomm, NXP, Texas Instruments, Intel and ST. Free skill-gap analysis inside.

items.title: Razorpay, PhonePe, Paytm, CRED and Intuit show where fintech hiring is focused
items.summary: A fresh look at 257 fintech jobs across Razorpay, PhonePe, Paytm, CRED and Intuit. Free skill-gap analysis inside.

items.title: Hiring Map May 2026: 5 Surprises in 30,000+ India Jobs
items.summary: After tracking more than 30,000 jobs from MNC career pages, the data tells a different story. Pune outranks Hyderabad. Two pharma companies post 1,000 roles. 'Collaboration' is listed 229 times and required 3. Free skill-gap analysis inside.

items.title: AI Hiring April 2026: Banks Beat Big Tech
items.summary: Real April 2026 hiring data: banks are out-hiring Big Tech for AI roles, 'Prompt Engineer' postings hit zero, and the work is in India. Free skill-gap analysis inside.
